_comment: Copy this file into a project as .claude/dado-web-quality.json and edit it.
Nothing reads it automatically: it is a written agreement about what the checks
mean for this project, which the skills read when you point them at it.
Every value below is an example. Replace all of them with your project's real
requirements. Do not ship these defaults as if they were your standard.
Exact strings that must appear verbatim and must not be reworded by an edit.
Use this for official organisation names, legally exact job titles, and any
wording the owner has approved. Fill in your own; the entries below are
placeholders and are deliberately not real names.
Wording that must never reappear after it was removed once — old company
names, superseded titles, wrong locations, retired product names.

lighthouse._comment: Thresholds are a project decision, not a universal standard.
